Lead Test Engineer Aptiv Braga, Portugal Job Responsibilities: Work on test software, hardware, and application specific tooling for assigned product programs Develop and optimize manufacturing functional tests (electrical) Develop statement of work (SOW) for test and programming processes/equipment Support kick-off meetings and MSD workshops with/in the PML for the assigned project Enforce proper requirements management for the assigned test process Facilitate test coverage analysis process, ensuring adequate test coverage for the assigned test process, request design changes in case test coverage issues in early design phase Utilize 6-Sigma for Test Statistical Analysis Methods to optimize CPK performance of parametric electrical tests Track needed test equipment/tools, ensure availability of needed material for all equipment/tool development Perform test equipment buy-off at suppliers, drive capability studies, strain measurement, create list of key parameters to be transferred to quality plan Work out proper documentation of the assigned test process, respect the APTIV processes and procedures accordingly Provide equipment training to PML test engineers, latest after PV Participate in escalation meetings on program management level on demand Support global Test Site team for agreed/defined tasks for post series test processes Qualifications: Bachelor degree or similar with technical education Proficient software development skills in one or more of the following software languages: National Instruments LabView, NI LabWindows CVI, NI TestStand, C++, C Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, LVDS, Flex-Ray, Broad@Reach and flashing concepts of memory devices Knowledge in SSFT and statistical methods Good problem solving capability Ability to work and live a global network environment Energetic, self-motivated, and proactive work style Business fluent English Apply Now Don't forget to mention EuroTechJobs when applying.
